evidence.title: Patricia Krenwinkel, former Manson follower, granted parole for third time

occurrences.checkable_against: Keith Wattley's public statement urging Gavin Newsom to approve Krenwinkel's release
occurrences.quote_span: Wattley, founder of UnCommon Law, a non-profit organization that represents people at parole hearings, urged Newsom to “uphold the law” and approve Krenwinkel’s freedom
occurrences.speaker: Keith Wattley
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Gavin Newsom's 2022 parole review decision for Patricia Krenwinkel
occurrences.quote_span: But he argued she had “not developed sufficient insight into the causative factors of her crime and her triggers for antisocial thinking” and was still dangerous.
occurrences.speaker: Gavin Newsom
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: California Board of Parole Hearings decision record for Patricia Krenwinkel
occurrences.quote_span: Patricia Krenwinkel, a former Charles Manson follower, was granted parole on Tuesday after nearly six decades in prison for her role in the infamous Tate-LaBianca murders in Los Angeles.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Patricia Krenwinkel's 1971 conviction record and criminal case records
occurrences.quote_span: She was convicted in 1971 for her role in the violent crime spree over two nights that claimed the lives of actor Sharon Tate, who was eight months pregnant, and her four friends, and grocery owner Leno LaBianca and his wife, Rosemary.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Keith Wattley's statement on Krenwinkel's responsibility
occurrences.quote_span: “She fully accepts responsibility for her actions, everything she contributed to, and every life she destroyed in 1969. Pat does not excuse or minimize that harm.”
occurrences.speaker: Keith Wattley
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Gavin Newsom's Sirhan Sirhan parole decision and public statements by Kennedy's sons
occurrences.quote_span: Newsom also faced scrutiny for overturning the parole grant of Sirhan Sirhan, convicted of assassinating Robert F Kennedy, even after two of Kennedy’s sons favored his release.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: California prison disciplinary records and Krenwinkel's psychological evaluation records
occurrences.quote_span: Over her decades in prison, Krenwinkel has had a clean disciplinary record, and nine consecutive psychological evaluations in the past 40 years have found her to be a low public safety risk, according to Wattley, who has represented Krenwinkel for 16 years.
occurrences.speaker: Keith Wattley
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Gavin Newsom's 2025 parole review decision for Patricia Krenwinkel
occurrences.quote_span: When Newsom again denied her parole in 2025, he also acknowledged her “serious chronic medical conditions” had diminished her strength, but concluded she “must do additional work to deepen her insight before she can be safely released”.
occurrences.speaker: Gavin Newsom
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Keith Wattley's statement issued after the California parole grant
occurrences.quote_span: “Reaching this moment has taken decades of hard, deliberate work to confront who she was, what she did, and the devastating harm she caused,” her longtime lawyer, Keith Wattley, said in a statement after the parole grant.
occurrences.speaker: Keith Wattley
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: California appeals court ruling and Gavin Newsom's parole decision concerning Leslie Van Houten
occurrences.quote_span: Newsom previously vetoed the release of Leslie van Houten, another former Manson follower, but an appeals court sided with her and granted her freedom in 2023.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: California Board of Parole Hearings records and Gavin Newsom's gubernatorial parole decisions for Patricia Krenwinkel
occurrences.quote_span: After both of her last two parole grants, Gavin Newsom, California’s governor, reversed the parole board’s decisions and denied her freedom, and Krenwinkel’s attorneys are now urging the Democrat to allow this latest ruling to stand.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: California Board of Parole Hearings records for Patricia Krenwinkel
occurrences.quote_span: This is the third time that Krenwinkel, 78, has been approved for release by California’s board of parole hearings.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation incarceration records and California Board of Parole Hearings decisions
occurrences.quote_span: Krenwinkel, who was 21 at the time of the 1969 killings, has been imprisoned longer than any other woman in California, and the parole board has repeatedly acknowledged her record of rehabilitation over 57 years in prison, concluding she would not in her elderly age be a danger to society.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: California prison program, education and service-dog training records
occurrences.quote_span: He said she has participated in extensive therapy and group counseling, earned a college degree and trained service dogs for people with disabilities.
occurrences.speaker: Keith Wattley
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Keith Wattley's statement after the parole grant
occurrences.quote_span: “I have seen the depth of her remorse and the extraordinary work she has done to change her life. I firmly believe she is ready to return home,” Wattley added.
occurrences.speaker: Keith Wattley
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Krenwinkel's attorneys' statements and case records
occurrences.quote_span: Krenwinkel was 19 years old when she “fell under Charles Manson’s control” and was exploited and psychologically abused by the cult leader, her attorneys have said.
occurrences.speaker: Krenwinkel's attorneys
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Interviews with Krenwinkel's friends and California women's prison records
occurrences.quote_span: Krenwinkel’s longtime friends from inside California’s women’s prison told the Guardian last year that she was a mentor and support system to others in the prison.
occurrences.speaker: Krenwinkel's longtime friends
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: California parole review statutes and gubernatorial review procedures
occurrences.quote_span: The governor is required to consider her elderly age and that she committed the crime as a youth in his review of her case.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Public statements by Debra Tate regarding parole releases
occurrences.quote_span: Debra Tate, Sharon Tate’s sister, has repeatedly objected to the release of Krenwinkel and other Manson followers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: The Guardian's inquiry records and responses from the California governor's office
occurrences.quote_span: Spokespeople for Newsom did not immediately respond to an inquiry on Wednesday.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel

occurrences.checkable_against: Gavin Newsom's 2022 parole review decision for Patricia Krenwinkel
occurrences.quote_span: When Newsom denied Krenwinkel parole in 2022, after the board first found her suitable for release, the governor acknowledged that she had been a “victim of Mr Manson’s abuse” and said she had “matured in prison and engaged in commendable rehabilitative efforts”.
occurrences.speaker: Gavin Newsom
occurrences.subject: Patricia Krenwinkel
